CH-13.title: Authority SourceFreeze／Profile Tailoring／原 PI 的 18 領域

layers.name: source_identity_and_span
layers.rule: evidence.source must carry source_id + 64-hex sha256 + path + span; a bare id is not a source

layers.name: parent_child_polarity
layers.rule: every atomic requirement must carry its original parent sentence and its polarity (must/shall-not); a child that dropped 不得 refuses

layers.name: count_is_not_denominator
layers.rule: evidence.parent_child.claimed_children must equal the enumerated child list length; a parent count standing in for all children refuses

layers.name: taxonomy_does_not_rewrite_ids
layers.rule: evidence.taxonomy only classifies; evidence.taxonomy.rewrites_original_id must be false

layers.name: profile_veto_adds_depth_only
layers.rule: evidence.profile.veto must not remove an original requirement; evidence.profile.depth_delta must be >= 0

layers.name: pi_domains_non_empty
layers.rule: evidence.pi_domains must enumerate all 18 domains with a non-empty semantic input each

layers.name: real_git_top
layers.rule: evidence.repo.is_git_top must be true; the three workspace folders are not repositories

layers.name: head_matches_local
layers.rule: evidence.repo.head must be a 40-hex commit and evidence.repo.head_source must not be 'remote_main'

layers.name: path_scope_exact
layers.rule: writeset.paths must be an explicit list with a preimage digest per path; no glob and no root-wide scope

layers.name: reparse_and_collision
layers.rule: evidence.paths_checked must report reparse/junction/hardlink/case-collision checks as false

layers.name: dirty_split
layers.rule: when evidence.repo.dirty is true, evidence.dirty_split.own and .others must be listed separately; auto-clean is refused

layers.name: late_bind_compares_preimage
layers.rule: evidence.late_bind must compare original PI digest, current HEAD and per-path preimage, all with the record subject identity

CH-16.title: 跨庫 Typed ABI、Producer→Consumer、Same Subject 交接

layers.name: five_seams_enumerated
layers.rule: evidence.seams must enumerate S1..S5, each with producer, abi_id, abi_version, consumer

layers.name: field_map_and_join
layers.rule: each seam must carry a field_map and a join over subject_id/source_sha256/candidate/version; a missing join key refuses

layers.name: per_edge_ack
layers.rule: each seam needs its own ack with state ACK/NACK and payload_digest; one success JSON may not stand for five seams

layers.name: sidecar_separated
layers.rule: evidence.sidecar.mixed_into_strict must be false

layers.name: timeout_is_unknown
layers.rule: evidence.timeout_observed true with evidence.guessed_ack true refuses; a timeout is UNKNOWN, never ACK

layers.name: route_trigger
layers.rule: evidence.route.tool must be one of direct/delegation/kanban/swarm and evidence.route.trigger must justify that choice

layers.name: one_scheduler
layers.rule: evidence.second_scheduler must be false; a second SQLite scheduler refuses

layers.name: lease_and_budget
layers.rule: evidence.lease must carry work_id/generation/cursor and evidence.budget must carry max_turns/max_tokens

layers.name: resume_same_key
layers.rule: when evidence.interrupted is true, evidence.resume must reuse the same work_id/cursor and evidence.replayed must be false

layers.name: card_done_is_not_world
layers.rule: evidence.card_done true with evidence.world_result absent refuses

layers.name: no_cross_worker_credentials
layers.rule: evidence.home_shared must be false and no credential path may appear in writeset

layers.name: principal_separation
layers.rule: evidence.principals must list maker/checker/issuer/publisher and no two protected roles may share one principal id

layers.name: secrets_absent
layers.rule: no secret material in argv/url/log/commit/paths; evidence.secret_scan.must_be_clean must be true with a scanner digest

layers.name: source_is_data
layers.rule: evidence.source_instruction_executed must be false; source text never expands authority

layers.name: per_effect_permission
layers.rule: each of the six effects present must carry its own permission and preimage; a DEV grant may not serve a HOST_OPS effect

layers.name: negative_keeps_raw
layers.rule: evidence.negative_tests must keep the raw refusal and must not modify the oracle; evidence.oracle_modified must be false

layers.name: self_signed_independent_refused
layers.rule: evidence.claims_independent must be false; only a protected checker may issue an independent verdict
